description: Hidrante is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by APIN - Empresa Intermunicipal de Ambiente do Pinhal Interior, S.A.. This dataset contains geospatial information on hydrants, which are installations responsible for network handling, purging and use in case of fire, ensuring proper pressure and flow in the system. The dataset includes the location as well as other fields of information that characterise the hydrants. Coverage: APIN - Empresa Intermunicipal de Ambiente do Pinhal Interior, S.A.. The portal shows the English title as "Hydrating" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is APIN - Empresa Intermunicipal de Ambiente do Pinhal Interior, S.A.. Its keywords include abastecimento-de-agua, rede-de-agua, combate-a-incendios, bombeiros, hidrante. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
